title: Endocrinology Outpatient Note
text:
SUBJECTIVE: 69-year-old female presents for annual diabetic evaluation. Reports adherence to metformin 1000 mg BID. Self-monitored fasting blood sugars range 130-150 mg/dL.
OBJECTIVE: BP 126/78 mmHg, BMI 28.4 kg/m2. Bilateral lower extremity monofilament exam demonstrates intact sensation.
ASSESSMENT: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, uncontrolled based on recent HbA1c 7.8%.
PLAN: Add empagliflozin 10 mg once daily. Recommend medical nutrition therapy follow-up. Repeat HbA1c in 3 months.

text: FINDINGS: Right kidney measures 10.8 cm and left kidney measures 11.2 cm in bipolar length. title: Urgent Care Acute Musculoskeletal Note
text:
CHIEF COMPLAINT: Inversion injury to right lateral ankle sustained during recreational soccer 3 hours ago.
EXAMINATION: Significant edema and ecchymosis over anterior talofibular ligament. Point tenderness present over lateral malleolus, but able to bear weight for 4 steps. Ottawa ankle rules negative for bony tenderness.
ASSESSMENT: Grade II acute right lateral ankle sprain.
PLAN: RICE protocol (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation). Provide stirrup ankle brace. Oral naproxen 500 mg BID with food as needed. Re-evaluate if inability to bear weight persists beyond 5 days.

title: Surgical Inpatient Discharge Summary
text:
ADMISSION: Acute symptomatic cholelithiasis with recurrent biliary colic.
PROCEDURE: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy performed on 2024-08-14.
SUMMARY: 41-year-old male had an uncomplicated surgical resection. Vital signs remained stable post-op. Tolerated clear liquid diet progressing to low-fat soft diet. Surgical incisions clean, intact, and healing well with no erythema or discharge.
DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS: Avoid strenuous heavy lifting for 4 weeks. Low fat diet recommended for initial 2 weeks. Follow-up scheduled in 10 days.

title: Gallbladder Surgical Pathology
text:
SPECIMEN: Gallbladder, excision.
GROSS DESCRIPTION: Specimen consists of a previously opened gallbladder measuring 8.5 x 3.2 cm with serosa intact. Wall thickness up to 0.4 cm. Lumen contains multiple faceted greenish-black stones ranging from 0.4 to 1.1 cm.
MICROSCOPIC: Sections reveal muscular hypertrophy and chronic inflammatory infiltrate within the lamina propria. Rokitansky-Aschoff sinuses are prominent. No architectural dysplasia or malignancy identified.
DIAGNOSIS: Chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis. Negative for neoplasia.
